text.zh-CN: 脑卒中是脑部血流阻断或血管破裂引起脑损伤的急症。本页帮助识别危险和了解分型流程；尚未分清缺血或出血时，不能自行套用某一种卒中的治疗。
text.en: Stroke is an emergency caused by interrupted brain blood flow or a ruptured vessel. This entry explains recognition and classification; while the type is uncertain, treatment for one subtype cannot be applied automatically.
